method: Exact Git tree lexicographic path enumerator, strict UTF-8 per tracked OpenSpec Markdown blob, Python literal search and independent Git grep agreement for the four markers. The declarations census covers literal ID lines. Named relationship decisions also read the relevant current normative scope or compared frozen bytes.

affected.openspec/changes/dossier-run-tree-read-b: Exact predecessor REQ-048 block is the replacement subject. Preserve the other two requirements byte-for-byte.
affected.openspec/changes/polaris-dossier-attende: Prior reviewed candidate provides the exact attended patch and will require a version-link disposition at adoption.
affected.openspec/README.md: Effective family index and archived candidate inventory need consistent future readback.

explicitlyUnaffected.openspec/changes/polaris-dossier-one-com: Compared archived whole-file blob to the R3 bound subject. The new candidate leaves it frozen.
explicitlyUnaffected.openspec/changes/dossier-coverage-hold/p: Read the sole changed requirement and compared against the new subject scope. A-305 packet publication and role boundaries are inherited verbatim.
explicitlyUnaffected.openspec/changes/dossier-question-file/p: Read the declared question-input identity and continuity conditions. The projection consumes only an already eligible question and changes no question transition.
explicitlyUnaffected.openspec/changes/dossier-raw-read-disclo: Read the declared mode and channel boundary in A-51. The new subject retains the old REQ-048 source path and grants no new egress.

undecidable.settlement: A reference or its absence does not settle consumption. Review each unresolved path using its effective requirement or consumer contract against the exact version binding before claiming full reverse dependency coverage.
